status: Unadopted conditional mechanism specification; not an executable preregistration, source driver or launch.
scientific_status: Eligible mechanism question; usefulness and novelty unestablished. Ingredient overlap and present resource limits are not rejection criteria.
hypothesis: At the same initial mean logits and finite TRAIN Jensen penalty, graph-conditioned head covariance allocations can produce more useful later pooled CE than equally selected random and permuted-topology allocations.
pool: Arithmetic mean of raw member logits, then softmax/CE; scalar raw-logit mean then sigmoid/BCE analogue.
objective: Pinned native mean own-member TRAIN CE. Source private-gradient 1/M normalization must be retained.

inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.common_center: One prospective identical copied warm/common-descent state; its construction, checkpoint and common step bound by root. Every arm uses it.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.graph_span: Existing TRAIN CE graph-error VJP construction with one output support mode fixed before this separate test; no support selection inside selector.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.private_slice: Only head.R, after exact affine logit dependence and identical initial hidden states/fixed other factors are qualified. Current stem.S+head.R slice is not assumed affine.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.optimizer: Exact pinned native optimizer, learning rate, decay, private-gradient scaling and copied moment/step convention. No state resets.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.basis: Deterministic ordered rank-three orthonormal projected head basis with tolerance, pivot order and sign convention fixed before outcomes.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.construction_RNG: Separate fixed construction/permutation seeds; construction and rejected trials must not consume native continuation RNG.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.finite_tolerances: Mean-logit equality, nonnull class-centered responses, rank, TRAIN guards, D matching, bisection limit and tie/abstention tolerances require root source qualification.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.scale: One radius/cap fixed before outcomes; D0 from fixed first graph pair at that declared radius. No radius grid.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.trial_forward: Full-TRAIN dropout-off surrogate with all other training/buffer semantics bound explicitly; all trial state discarded.
inputs_to_bind_before_any_outcome.continuation: Unchanged pinned noisy native continuation, selector, pool, streams and fixed final endpoint.

algorithm: Take the root-bound common center and existing graph-error VJP columns at the explicitly bound construction state. Project only the head columns against the common TRAIN head gradient.
Form the ordered rank-three orthonormal basis. Rank<3 is a retained null/ineligible construction, without redraw, new slice or task substitution.
Enumerate only (v1,v2), (v1,v3), (v2,v3), in that order. For each pair use head offsets (s*vi,-s*vi,s*vj,-s*vj), M=4. Their parameter covariance is (s^2/2)*(vi*vi^T+vj*vj^T); max member radius is s.

Define D0 from the fixed first graph pair at the declared radius. Require a positive nondegenerate D0. Match each pair to D0 with bounded deterministic scalar search under the same radius cap. In the qualified affine antithetic limit D(s) is even convex and nondecreasing for s>=0; finite source qualification remains necessary.

Check finite initial mean-logit equality to the common center, matched D, nonnull class-centered response diagnostics and every existing TRAIN finite safeguard. Record every failure; no redraw/cap enlargement.

For every eligible candidate clone all shared/private weights, moments, step counters, buffers, RNG and relevant source state. Apply exactly one full-TRAIN dropout-off native own-CE optimizer trial update; evaluate full-TRAIN pooled CE after it.

Run the identical common-only trial once. Choose the eligible candidate with minimum post-trial pooled CE, fixed ties. If it does not improve the common trial by the prebound tolerance, abstain to common-only.
Discard all trial states. Return only the selected initialization in the original copied state/moment/step/RNG convention. Run the unchanged native continuation.

Apply the same projection, basis/rank, three-pair count, D/cap match, trial map, tie/abstention and continuation to the fixed node-permuted-topology and random spans. Optional TRAIN class-centered JVP Gram matching requires constructibility and disclosure of graph/label dependence.
not_guaranteed: Scalar D matching does not match the whole response covariance or isolate orientation completely.
The finite AdamW/shared-body/dropout-off trial is a proxy; the affine independent-SGD coefficient is not an exact description of the native continuation.
A selected TRAIN winner is favorable partly by construction; it is not heldout predictive evidence.
The binary symbolic witness does not realize the projected graph candidate.

representative_falsifier.backbone: Existing root-bound modern compatible backbone, one fixed native configuration. No new backbone grid.
representative_falsifier.primary_utility: Later pooled VALIDATION NLL under the unchanged native checkpoint selector.
representative_falsifier.secondary: Fixed final endpoint; accuracy/Brier/member competence and all costs retained.
representative_falsifier.construction_report: All three candidate values, all matching/rank/guard failures, initial mean-logit equality and D, finite common/candidate trial values. Early continuation checkpoints, if qualified, are frozen before outcomes.
stopping_rules: No eligible rank/D/finite construction or repeated common-only abstention stops selector promotion.
Failure to beat the fixed graph pair stops a lookahead-selection gain claim.
Random/permuted selected controls matching the graph arm stops graph-specific benefit promotion.
Improvement explained by different mean logits, larger D, optimizer resets or extra candidate budget is confounded.
representative_falsifier.broad_GNNM_comparators: Competent single/native BE/packed independent controls required by surrounding research remain required for broader quality/cost claims; these five arms are a local mechanism matrix.

confirmation.condition: Only after development pass and complete recipe freeze; root verifies use history and source compatibility.
confirmation.graph: One previously unused complete compatible graph, e.g. Amazon Computers only if admissible.
confirmation.test_label_policy: Open existing heldout labels once after complete freeze.
confirmation.claim_scope: Useful graph-prior initialization under this fixed contract, not novelty of the established ingredients or a scale/generalization theorem.
